title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 04
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'recommended actions' in a report should be
options: Specific, measurable, and actionable
Vague and non-specific in wording
General and non-actionable advice
Instructions received from the superior officer
questions.solution: Specific, measurable, and actionable.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cement grouted' roof bolt differs from resin by
options: Resin is weaker under tension load
Cement is always more expensive
Cement is always stronger in tensile strength
Cement takes longer to set than resin
questions.solution: Cement grout takes longer to set than resin grout.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'frequency' of reporting depends on
options: The type of activity and regulatory requirements
The number of public holidays observed in the year
The weather during the monsoon season
The personal preference of the mine owner
questions.solution: Type of activity and regulatory requirements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety committee' in a mine is constituted under
options: Section 41A of the Mines Act 1952
CMR 2017 Regulation 39
Section 7 of Mines Act 1952
The company's own safety charter
questions.solution: Section 7 of Mines Act 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'traverse' in mine surveying is used to
options: Measure the temperature of the surrounding rock
Measure the velocity of the air flowing in the mine roadway
Establish control points by measuring angles and distances
Record the temperature variations of the rock
questions.solution: Traverses establish control points by measuring angles and distances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, an Inspector may, among other powers:
options: Impose fines directly on the mine owner without holding an inquiry
Appoint, remove and suspend the mine officials of the undertaking
Withdraw or suspend permanently the certificates of competency of the mine officials concerned
Enter, inspect and examine a mine, and make inquiries on any matter relating to safety
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.22: Inspectors may enter, inspect, examine and inquire into any mine and its records.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: ASDL stands for
options: Automated Shuttle Car Loader
Articulated Shuttle Loader
Auxiliary Side Discharge Loader Unit
Articulated Side Discharge Loader
questions.solution: Articulated Side Discharge Loader.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hydraulic stowing' uses
options: Hand loading of the waste material by the miners
Steam pressure generated in a boiler house
Water pressure to transport stowing material
Belt conveyors placed along the stowing panel
questions.solution: Hydraulic stowing uses water pressure to transport material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When workings approach within 60 m of a water body or waterlogged area, the manager shall:
options: Stop all working immediately without any approved scheme or any written protection plan
Leave the water body completely untouched for the future workings
Inform the workers orally only about the nearby water inflow risk
Prepare a scheme for protection against inrush and drain the water in a planned manner
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 149 (danger from surface water) & Ch. XI: within 60 m, protective schemes (drainage, barriers) are implemented.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing pipeline diameter' selection depends on
options: The length of the pipeline only, ignoring the material
The colour of the pipe used for the line
The number of bends only in the pipeline
Material flow rate, velocity, and pump capacity
questions.solution: Pipeline diameter depends on flow rate, velocity, and pump capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum persons permitted in a single trip on a man riding system is
options: As decided from time to time by the mine operator alone
As per the designed capacity approved by the manager
Any number of persons not exceeding twenty
As many persons as can conveniently fit in
questions.solution: As per designed capacity approved by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must not be used if
options: It is the night shift or a holiday
It is raining heavily in the open
Any defect is found that affects safety
The workers are late for the beginning of the shift
questions.solution: Use must stop if any safety defect is found.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Roof bolting in coal mines uses
options: Resisting weight of the roof strata
Supporting the ribs in a longwall face
Cement or resin grouted bolts
Damping the firedamp in the return
questions.solution: Roof bolting uses cement or resin grouted bolts for support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pneumatic stowing' method uses
options: Hydraulic pressure of a high pressure water pump
Vacuum suction created by a compressor
Hand packing of the waste in the goaf
Compressed air to transport stowing material
questions.solution: Pneumatic stowing uses compressed air for material transport.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas chromatograph' is used to
options: Determines the age of the mine workings
Measures the temperature of the strata
Checks the strength of the roof bolts and the straps used
Analyze the composition of mine gases accurately
questions.solution: Analyzes the composition of mine gases accurately.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In return airways and old workings, the air shall normally contain oxygen not less than ______ and carbon dioxide not more than ______.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 165: not less than 19% oxygen and not more than 0.5% carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'fault' in geology is
options: A fracture in rock with displacement
A type of support system used in a heading
A type of mineral found in the seam
A type of coal seam in the district
questions.solution: A fault is a fracture with displacement of rock layers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'GIS application' in mining is used for
options: Levelling of the surface bench floors
Recording the attendance of miners
Drafting the mine ventilation plan and the air schedule
Spatial analysis and management of mine data
questions.solution: GIS provides spatial analysis and data management.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine must be operated by
options: The shot firer appointed for the district by the manager
The shotfirer working on the night shift
A competent person designated by the manager
The overman of the underground workings
questions.solution: A competent person designated by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'underground fire' in coal mines can be caused by
options: Spontaneous heating, mining activities, or external sources
Improper handling of hot slag or friction sparks at the coal face
Failure of the ventilation and cooling system
Stone dust barriers of inadequate thickness in the roadway
questions.solution: Underground fires can be from spontaneous heating, mining, or external sources.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue station' must have
options: A list of the telephone numbers of hospitals
Only a first aid box kept in the mine office
Trained personnel and equipment for emergency response
A large wall map of the mine surface and underground workings
questions.solution: Rescue stations must have trained personnel and equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal quality' is determined by
options: Proximate analysis of the coal sample only
Calorific value, ash content, moisture, volatile matter
The colour of the overlying strata of the working coal seam
The distance of the seam from the surface
questions.solution: Coal quality depends on CV, ash, moisture, and volatile matter.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding indicator must show
options: The speed of the winding engine at any instant of time
The position of the cage in the shaft at all times
The depth of the shaft below the collar
The load carried on the winding rope only
questions.solution: Must show cage position at all times.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bord' in bord and pillar refers to
options: The width of the heading driven between pillars
The height of the coal seam being mined
The length of the pillar between the bords
The size of the goaf left behind the longwall face
questions.solution: Width of the heading between pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A surface miner is used for
options: Used for blasting the overburden seam
Mechanized surface mining without blasting
Used for hauling coal to the washery
Used for drilling the vertical blast holes in overburden
questions.solution: Mechanized surface mining without blasting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support spacing' in underground mines is determined by
options: Load conditions, support capacity, and span
Control of the dust emissions in the underground roadway
The colour of the steel support used
Fixed and identical for all the mines
questions.solution: Support spacing depends on load, capacity, and span.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The accident investigation must focus on
options: Punishing the person who made the error
Estimating the cost of the lost shift
Blaming the workers who were involved in the accident
Finding the root cause and preventing recurrence
questions.solution: Finding the root cause and preventing recurrence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'body temperature monitoring' of rescue team members is important because
options: To check the strength of the rescue equipment
It is not at all necessary for the rescue work
To detect heat stress and prevent collapse of team members
To decide the route and speed of travel of the rescue team
questions.solution: To detect heat stress and prevent collapse.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An electrical permit to work system is required for
options: The chemical resistance of the components
Any repair of mechanical components in the mine section
Work on live or potentially live electrical equipment
All mechanical repairs of any kind whatsoever
questions.solution: Work on live or potentially live electrical equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'high-potential incident' is one that
options: Had the potential to cause a serious or fatal injury
Caused only minor injuries to the persons
Involved no machinery of any kind whatsoever
Caused no injury, loss or damage of any kind at all
questions.solution: Had the potential to cause a serious or fatal injury.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire extinguishing medium' selection depends on
options: The cost of the extinguisher only, ignoring the risk
Simply the cheapest medium available
Type of fire, location, and safety requirements
The colour of the extinguisher body shell
questions.solution: Medium selection depends on fire type, location, safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal dust becomes explosive when it is
options: Suspended in air in sufficient concentration
Lying loose on the ground in the mine roadway floor
Mixed with water or a fine wet mist
Packed tightly against the mine floor
questions.solution: Coal dust becomes explosive when suspended in sufficient concentration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast round' in drifting typically includes
options: Only the cut holes with no lifter holes
Explosive charges placed in the holes before stemming
A single large hole drilled at the face
Cut holes, easer holes, lifters, and lifter holes
questions.solution: Cut holes, easer holes, lifters, and lifter holes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: If the percentage of inflammable gas in the general body of air exceeds ______, persons shall be withdrawn from the working.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 166: persons are withdrawn when the general body of air exceeds 1.25% inflammable gas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'mine plan' shows
options: All working areas, benches, ramps, dumps, infrastructure
The position of the ventilation fan installations underground
The slopes of the surface overburden dumps
The electric power lines of the mine surface
questions.solution: Mine plans show all operational areas and infrastructure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team deployment' underground follows
options: Based on the weather forecast for the surface
Decided only at the time of the rescue
Planned deployment with team composition and route
Random deployment of the team underground without any plan
questions.solution: Deployment follows planned team composition and route.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'methane' in coal mines is dangerous because
options: It is heavier than air and collects in the low lying places
It is explosive when mixed with air in certain proportions
It is dangerous only near the water inflows
It cools the underground workings of the mine
questions.solution: Methane is explosive when mixed with air (5-15% concentration).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The dust suppression methods include
options: Water sprays, stone dusting, ventilation, and surfactants
Restricted to the development headings of the underground mine
Applied only after the working shift has ended
Limited to the return airway of the district
questions.solution: Multiple methods are used for dust suppression.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Approaching a goaf, probing shall be carried out ahead of the working for at least:
options: 3 m
5 m
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 147: the working is probed ahead for at least 1.5 m beyond the last support before approaching the goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Continuous miners are used in
options: Stowing of the abandoned goaf areas
The winding of the men and the coal in the shaft cages
Room and pillar operations for coal extraction
The opencast working of the coal mine
questions.solution: Continuous miners are used in room and pillar for coal extraction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coordinate system' in mine surveying uses
options: Arbitrary and isolated datum levels
Reference grid for positioning mine features
To monitor the gas concentrations
To measure the air velocity in the underground roadways
questions.solution: Coordinate systems use reference grids for positioning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing' in mining is done to
options: To drain the water from the workings
Allow free flow of air through the goaf
Reduce the cost of surface rehabilitation
Fill the goaf to control subsidence
questions.solution: Stowing fills the goaf to control surface subsidence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'test run' of the winding engine must be carried out
options: Once in every six months and entered in the records
Once in every calendar year of service
On Monday mornings at the start of the week
Before winding persons at the start of each shift
questions.solution: Before winding persons at start of each shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'inundation report' must mention
options: Source of water, rate of inflow, and measures taken to control it
The number of persons on leave on the day of the report
The list of all machinery working in the underground
The monthly production target fixed for the underground mine as a whole
questions.solution: Source, rate, and measures taken.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A circuit in a mine must be protected against
options: Overload, short circuit, and earth leakage
Harmonic distortion in the mine supply system
Voltage regulation of the supply only
The colour of the cable used underground
questions.solution: Overload, short circuit, and earth leakage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'refuge hole' or 'manhole' in a track-based man riding system is provided for
options: Loading of the coal in the mine gate
Persons to take shelter if a vehicle approaches
Storing of the tools, lamps and rods
Dumping of the muck and of the blasted stone in the goaf
questions.solution: Persons to take shelter if a vehicle approaches.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'serious accident' is one that
options: Causes only minor bruises to the persons
Causes the loss of a limb or of a permanent disability
Causes fracture of any bone or severe bodily injury
Is not reported to the manager or the owner
questions.solution: Causes fracture of any bone or severe bodily injury.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'operating ratio' of shovel is
options: The working hours of the shovel per day
The operating cost of the shovel per unit of output
The number of operators per shift
Actual output/theoretical maximum output
questions.solution: Operating ratio measures actual vs. theoretical output.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A sirdar holding charge of a section must take
options: A verbal message passed on by the overman to the sirdar
A charge handover taken only at the weekend
A proper charge handover from the previous sirdar
A report filed only after the shift ends
questions.solution: A proper charge handover from the previous sirdar is mandatory.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'emergency report' should be
options: Posted to the manager's office after a month
Detailed, lengthy and purely descriptive of fault
Written and submitted only after a full week
Brief, factual, and transmitted immediately to the manager
questions.solution: Brief, factual, and transmitted immediately.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bearing' of a line in surveying refers to
options: The weight of the tape or survey line
Angle of the line with reference direction
The measured length of the survey line
The colour of the station peg or line
questions.solution: Bearing is the angle of a line with a reference direction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The voltage used for lighting underground in coal mines is typically
options: 11kV
110V or 220V
questions.solution: Typically 110V or 220V for lighting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: While driving approaching old or waterlogged workings, advance boreholes shall be kept at least ______ ahead of the face.
options: 3 m
1 m
6 m
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 163: at least 3 advance boreholes not less than 3 m ahead of the face, with flank holes within 5 m on either side.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The load on a man riding rope must not exceed
options: Twice the safe designed load
The full breaking strength
The safe working load as designed
Half of the breaking load of the rope
questions.solution: The load must not exceed the designed safe working load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'haulage' in underground mines refers to
options: The extraction and working of the pillars
The supporting of the roof in the workings
Transport of coal and materials from face to surface
The ventilating of the underground mine workings
questions.solution: Haulage is the transport of coal and materials.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire extinguisher inspection' frequency should be
options: Monthly visual and annual maintenance checks
Only during the rainy season of the year
Kept only inside the surface mine office
Once in every ten years of operation
questions.solution: Extinguishers need monthly visual and annual maintenance checks.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ultimate analysis' of coal determines
options: The moisture held in the coal as mined
The ash left after complete incineration
The volatile matter driven off on heating
Carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, sulfur, oxygen content
questions.solution: Ultimate analysis determines C, H, N, S, O content.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The manager must conduct an inquiry into
options: Accidents causing loss of life
Minor injuries recorded in the day book
Every serious and dangerous occurrence
Electrical faults reported by the electrician
questions.solution: Every serious and dangerous occurrence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'closing error' in a traverse must be within
options: Exactly zero at every single traverse station
Exactly zero at every survey traverse station
Whatever error limit the surveyor decides to fix
The permissible limit as prescribed by survey regulations
questions.solution: The permissible limit as prescribed by regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety audit in a mine is conducted to
options: Check the daily attendance of all the mine workers
Verify only the mine survey plans and the levels
Check the daily production output of the coal mine
Identify safety hazards and assess compliance with regulations
questions.solution: Identify safety hazards and assess regulatory compliance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing pump selection' depends on
options: The colour of the pump housing body
Simply the cheapest available pump unit
Head, capacity, and material characteristics
Only on the size of the stowing dam
questions.solution: Pump selection depends on head, capacity, and material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overcast' or 'air crossing' allows
options: The complete recirculation of the air
A single split of the air current
The fresh air intake at the surface
Two air currents to cross without mixing
questions.solution: Overcasts allow air currents to cross without mixing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: On the occurrence of a misfire, the hole shall:
options: Be abandoned, left unfired and reported to the manager after a week
Not be probed, and the shot shall be dealt with by the shot-firer of the next shift
Be probed immediately by a competent person with a long steel rod
Be refired at once by the same shot-firer without any delay or wait
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 204: a misfired hole is not probed; it is dealt with by the shot-firer of the succeeding shift, with a report to the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety device in a man riding system includes
options: Automatic braking of the cage on overspeed
An interlock on the doors of the winding cage
Anti-rollback device, speed governor, and safety catch
The automatic restarting of the hoist motor
questions.solution: Multiple safety devices are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'timing of support withdrawal' in depillaring depends on
options: Support of the conveyor belts in the face
Protect the electrical equipment of the section
A time fixed in advance by the mine contractor
Goaf conditions, roof behavior, and extraction progress
questions.solution: Withdrawal timing depends on goaf conditions and extraction progress.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine water pumping record' must be maintained by
options: The mine manager only, and not the pumpman
The mine store keeper in the office
The security guard at the mine gate
The person responsible for pumping operations
questions.solution: The person responsible for pumping operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that all persons under him
options: Work only during the night shift of the day
Are above eighteen years of age only
Are trained and understand safety procedures
Work without any safety equipment
questions.solution: All persons must be trained and understand safety procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air quantity' required depends on
options: Number of workers, equipment, and gas emissions
The colour of the coal from the seam
The depth of the shaft from the collar
The same quantity fixed for all mines
questions.solution: Air quantity depends on workers, equipment, and gas emissions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'extraction ratio' in board and pillar mining is typically
questions.solution: Extraction ratio in board and pillar is typically 40-60% in first working.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Drifting in mining refers to
options: Sinking a vertical shaft through the coal seam
Driving horizontal or near-horizontal openings in rock
Raising ore from an underground stope face
Removing overburden from an open pit bench
questions.solution: Driving horizontal or near-horizontal openings in rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'mine plan' must be kept updated because
options: It is only needed for the annual report of the mine
It is only needed for royalty assessment purposes
It is only required for the opencast mine plans
It is a legal requirement and essential for safety and planning
questions.solution: Legal requirement and essential for safety and planning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'notice of opening or abandonment of a mine' must be given to
options: The local workers' union of the mine
The local magistrate of the mining area
The registered miners' union of the area
The inspector of mines and the Chief Inspector
questions.solution: To the inspector of mines and the Chief Inspector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stoppings' in underground mines are used to
options: Provide support to the roof strata
Allow the passage of persons
Direct airflow by sealing off areas
Store the mining materials in the section
questions.solution: Stoppings are permanent walls to direct airflow in mine ventilation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'foam-based fire suppression' is effective for
options: Fires of the firedamp gas in the workings
Class A and B fires including coal and oil fires
The coal dust explosions in the roadways
Fires in the surface winding engine room
questions.solution: Class A and B fires including coal and oil fires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'fatal accident' under the Mines Act is one that
options: Causes a serious injury lasting a month
Causes only a minor injury
Results in death of any person
Happens only during day shift
questions.solution: A fatal accident results in death of any person.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'quality' of a report depends on
options: Exclude all the numerical data and the field figures
Only on the total length of the written report text
Accuracy of information, clarity of expression, and completeness
Use of very informal and casual spoken language in it
questions.solution: Accuracy, clarity, and completeness.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In every mine, the shot-firer shall be provided with a reserve station (a suitable sheltered place) and, where required:
options: An additional battery and a spare carbide lamp box unit
A telephone instrument kept at every single working face
A relay of persons posted between the shot-firer and the firing station
A second shot-firer permanently posted on the same panel
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 193: a RESERVE STATION is provided, with a relay of persons between the shot-firer and the firing station to transmit signals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water dam' in mines is built to
options: Store the drinking water for the mine workers
Control and direct water flow in underground workings
Provide support to the roof and to the mine ribs
Store the explosives used in the underground mine
questions.solution: Water dams control and direct water flow underground.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'dangerous occurrence' is
options: A planned and approved blasting operation
An occurrence which could have led to an accident
Only an accident in which a person died
A normal routine operation of the mine
questions.solution: An occurrence which could have led to an accident.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A trailing cable in a mine must be
options: Flexible, flame-retardant, and adequately insulated
Of any length and of any size of gauge
Used only at the rated voltage of the supply
A rigid and bare copper conductor cable
questions.solution: Flexible, flame-retardant, and adequately insulated.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Talcher coalfield is located in
options: Odisha
Maharashtra
Chhattisgarh
Jharkhand
questions.solution: Talcher coalfield is in Odisha.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A is B's brother. B is C's sister. C is D's father. How is A related to D?
options: Father
Grandfather
Brother
Uncle
questions.solution: A is D's uncle.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The largest coalfield in India is
options: Raniganj
Jharia
Talcher
Singrauli
questions.solution: Singrauli coalfield is one of the largest in India.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL's washed coal' supply helps
options: Increase the moisture content of the coal
Reduce the size of coal fed to the boiler
Eliminate the need for the boiler blowdown
Reduce ash content and improve power plant efficiency
questions.solution: Reduces ash and improves efficiency.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'clean coal technologies' in India include
options: Underground mining by longwall only
Surface mining without drilling
CFBC, AFBC, and IGCC technologies
Burning of coal in an open hearth furnace
questions.solution: CFBC, AFBC, and IGCC technologies.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal bed methane' (CBM) is extracted from
options: Coal seams before or during mining
The abandoned spoil heaps on the surface
The seams already worked out
The deep boreholes drilled for water supply
questions.solution: Extracted from coal seams before or during mining.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'flue gas desulfurization' (FGD) in power plants removes
options: Removes dust from mine air
Reduces air velocity below limits
Sulfur dioxide from flue gases
Purifies water for drinking
questions.solution: FGD removes sulfur dioxide from flue gases.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The capital of Maharashtra is
options: Nagpur
Mumbai
Nashik
Pune
questions.solution: Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A table shows: Mine A=200, Mine B=350, Mine C=450. What percentage does Mine C contribute?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which Mughal emperor built the Taj Mahal?
options: Shah Jahan
Akbar
Jahangir
Aurangzeb
questions.solution: Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A bar chart shows Q1: 200, Q2: 250, Q3: 300, Q4: 350. Total for the year?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal washeries' in India are used to
options: Reduce ash content and improve coal quality
Removal of sulphur from the coal
Drying the coal for the domestic market
Disposal of the mine water pumped out
questions.solution: Washeries reduce ash and improve coal quality.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Pick odd: Copper, Iron, Gold, Silver
options: Silver
Iron
Copper
Gold
questions.solution: Copper is base metal; others are precious.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL) is a
options: A wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Ltd
A wholly owned Central Government company
Joint venture of Telangana and Central Government
A private limited company of Telangana
questions.solution: SCCL is a joint venture of Telangana and Government of India.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Antonym of 'Ephemeral' is
options: Temporary
Lasting
Brief
Fleeting
questions.solution: Lasting is opposite of ephemeral.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Indian School of Mines' (now IIT ISM) is located in
